name: host-usage-capture-unify
title: Unify host-side LLM usage capture: launcher choke-point ledger rows (M1) plus a read-only retro-attribution usage sweep (M2)
description: A 2026-07-10 forensic token-burn audit found .lattice/usage/llm-usage.jsonl contains only 4 probe records from 2026-06-19 while the real burns were all host-side and invisible to the ledger: a 30-hour Codex Desktop thread in the legacy Work/Orchestrate directory accumulated 368.9M cumulative input tokens (~4,700 turns), five parallel codex exec reviewers for one story burned ~16M input in about one minute, and Claude-side reviewer sessions burned 4-8M new input each. Attribution required manual archaeology over ~/.codex/sessions rollouts and ~/.claude/projects transcripts. M1 extends the canonical launcher path (standardized by B-d8ef) so every lattice-initiated host run (dispatch, reviewer launch, quorum host review, autopilot) writes usage rows with storyId/agentType/phase/provider bound. M2 productizes the manual forensic analysis as a read-only usage sweep command that scans host transcript stores since a cutoff and emits a clearly non-authoritative attribution report. Usage data stays diagnostics-only (gateEvidence=false); interactive desktop sessions are report-only via M2, never intercepted.
